nom: Pixi Glow Tonic 5% Glycolic Acid Exfoliating Toner

avis.texte: I love how this toner feels and smells. It was one of the first products I tried when I first got into skincare. I stopped using it so I could try out new products, but I recently purchased this again and I like it even more now then I did when I was younger. Sometimes I just wear the toner out and nothing else. My skin looks so clear and polished.

I'm confused by the reviews because it seems some people are referring to pads. The product I received is a goopy gel. The scent and texture feel like I'm putting cheap hand soap or laundry detergent on my face. I'm not sure how anyone could like this. I think it leaves my skin OK but I would definitely not re-purchase.

I usually use the Glycolic lAcid liquid toner, but decided to try the pads, because of their convenience to travel with. I use to love the Bliss Glycolic Acid pads in a blue box that were individually wrapped, but they aren't available in stores anymore. These pads are too thin and not very saturated with moisture, but thet have a good textured exfoliating side. I end up using 2 exfoliating pads, because they are so thin. They have not caused any skin irritation on my face or neck, but I prefer to using the Pixi liquid glycolic acid toner in the bottle.

avis.titre: If it smelled better it would be absolutely perfect.
avis.texte: These pads are wonderful - not too harsh but still very effective. The only downside is the smell. If they could adjust the fragrance or remove the odor they would be perfect.
I'm not sure I agree with the description of "gentle@ exfoliation. I can tolerate many products but this one stings and burns.
Horrifying smell of old lady soap- this thing could work wonders but smells like absolute garbage and i wont use it

avis.titre: Works great but a little thick
avis.texte: Leaves my skin feeling hydrated and revitalized but product is pretty thick which is the only complaint I have

I have been using Pixi products for years and they never disappoint! I have tried more expensive products and always go back to Pixi. This tonic leaves my skin feeling fresh, clean and looking amazing.

Delivers on its promises: exfoliates, evens out tone, and smooths. Leaves the skin soft and reduces texture on my nose and cheeks very well. I use it about every other day. It does cause the skin to peel when it starts working so I use a gentle scrub mask weekly to help buff it off. Smells like my late grandmother's toner (in a good way) and doesn't irritate despite its effectiveness.
I love the feel of this cleansing gel! My skin always feels so soft after I use it. I have Definitely noticed more of a glow to my skin too! I'll definitely be purchasing this again in the future! 🥰
i like this exfoliator. it doesnt irritate my skin and it leaves it feeling soft. i dont love the way it smells and i do wish it had cleaner ingredients.

This glow tonic is by far my favorite product ever! It smells absolutely amazing and is without a doubt the best toner I have ever used. It's not harsh on your skin, doesn't burn or react with other facial products, and leaves your skin with a gorgeous glow. I've recommended this product to so many of my friends and family and they all love it too. It's worth every penny!
I'm having a hard time choosing my favorite Pixi cleanser - they are all fantastic!
Literally use it everyday and helps in so many ways! Great for sensitive skin!

This glow tonic really cleans my skin. I double cleanse, thinking that's enough but after using the tonic, I see some dirt on the cotton pads. My skin feels clean and has a glow. I have combination skin and this is perfect for every other day use.
Guyssssss! This is a super solution. This removes dark spots from picking pimples on the face and neck so well!!!! BUY IT! BUY IT! BUY IT!
Glow Tonic does exactly what it claims to doLove my skin is absolutely brighter and healthier lookingIt's an absolute must
Very gentle cleanser and I feel like my skin is more clear and brighter. Love it!
Great results, I was skeptical on using.I have discoloration on my cheeks, started to use and was surprised to see some decrease in texture and clearing of dark spots.Highly recommend.
Very affordable. I have been using it for years. It does its magic. At first it's not noticeable but after a week you notice the difference. One of my holy grails, wouldn't change it for anything
Nothing has done more to even out my complexion than this serum!

I had never used glow tonic before and I am so happy I started! I love it so much. It's inspired me to continue to keep up with my routine morning and night. It's super refreshing and simply feels great going on. It doesn't have an alcohol feel it doesn't make my skin irritated like other brands. It feels so refreshing! I love this product!!
After one use, my skin showed a marked improvement! I can't wait to see what glow up this is gonna give my skin!!!!
I got this a sample and it makes my skin soft. It is not sticky and My face feels refreshed.
I love these pads. They have made my skin look and feel so much better. They are gentle on the skin and work wonders!
My favorite toner, it helps my oily skin glow without the grease!
I absolutely love this toner soooo much, this is the best toner I have used ever. This toner leaves my skin feeling so clean and refreshed.
This has got to be the best astringent I've ever used! I love love love everything Pixi ❤️ I always tell everyone about it!

avis.titre: My face burns like on a grill
avis.texte: i like to use other Pixi products, but this tonic burnt my face and neck so much and my face would stay so red for the next 3-4 hours. I do not know, what was the cause. Maybe my skin barrier is not good. dont know. otherwise loved the scent and packaging. Price is affordable.

avis.titre: Easy to use and travel friendly!
avis.texte: I bough these to use during travels in order not to carrie bottle with liquids and cotton pads. However, I ended up using these before applying my make up. They are perfect exfoliant before for smoother application !
I'm not sure this is that good the first thing I noticed when I used it is the strange smell and it does not go away immediately. I usually love all their products but this I e is a little drying
Nice Tonic but I prefer the Collagen Botanical Tonic maybe because I'm an "older" gal who benefits from the collagen!
The cold air has my face so dry it looks terrible but with this syrup my skin stays hydrated all day and the texture is perfect! My skin feel amazing even right after applying it!

Love this tonic! My skin looks brighter and clearer since I started using this tonic. I apply it every morning and evening. I especially see the difference in my decolletage. It was so slotchy but has cleared up quite a bit.
Been using this product for at least 3 years. My skin thanks me everyday for this product
This is one of my favorite products! My skin has not looked so good since I have started using Pixi products, definitely recommend!
I love the whole glow series! But this serum just transforms my face incredibly!

This is part of my nightly routine, leaves yoy feeling so fresh and glowing not tacky or sticky and don't leave a smell. I even buy the small bottle for my travels. It last super long time for the price!
I love this toner! It makes my skin glow, hydrates my skin and makes my skin smooth.
Again, just try it out! Use it for a few days and you'll see that dewy, healthy glow! Love this stuff!

avis.titre: My fave product in a mini
avis.texte: My favorite product in a mini perfect for travel. If you've never used this product before, USE IT! After a couole days, you will see the glow! You're skin will look dewy without any makeup on. I often don't have to wear any to go out, just a swipe of lip gloss and mascara or eye shadow bc my skin looks so great from this stuff!
Big bottle for a sample! I really liked this toner, very moisturizing!
Been using this for years. Love the way it makes my skin feel and look!
Very surprised by the refreshing feeling of this tonic. No need for the fridge with this one. I have very dry skin so I am not sure if this one is for me or not, but doggone it.....I'm in love!
Ever since starting to use Glow Tonic everyday, my skin is so much clearer and more even toned. I rarely wear liquid make up anymore. Powder and blush and away I go.
Love this tonic because with it my skin is more balanced and not so much fat and pores have become less noticeable

First discovered Glow Tonic about 5 years ago and been a loyal user since. Love how it makes my since look so much healthier, definitely recommend for all that want to have brighter healthier looking skin. I use it both morning and night!
The cool tonic, long ago wanted to try it and was very pleased with the result. 5% glycolic acid is very comfortable perceived by my skin and face becomes more glowing
I have been using this tonic regularly for over a year now. It's easy to use and I feel that it keeps my skin in good condition when used about once a week.
I actually buy this and squirt it inside every new container of glow tonic pads I get. I like the pads to be more saturated with the toner and this is perfect for that.

I use these pads after I wash my face. They have a nice subtle smell and will give your face nice glow that will last for the day. They're especially good for your face if your skin looks dry after washing it.
I love this product 🥰I use this every morning & evening. My face has never looked better♥️

avis.titre: A little goes a long way!
avis.texte: This serum is medium bodied and spreads very easily. Just a small swipe across each cheekbone is enough to spread across my entire face, under my chin, and neck. I use this morning and evening and like adding it after my cleanser + toner routine. It feels pretty sticky at first, but smooths and softens after I rub it in.

I've been using ,twice a week to refresh my skin and so far my reaction to this is positive, not harsh, tingles a bit, no irritation and non drying. First time using a exfoliating liquid. I recommend this product. Be sure to use SPF when you go outside after using this, since it may make you more sensitive to the sun.
Best for on the road as it is difficult to transfer from the larger tonic bottle to any type of travel bottle.
This is a great cleanser but I only gave 4 stars because it doesn't lather up for me like the clarifying cleanser does. It seems I have to use more of it for a good clean.
I have been using this for a long time now and it's my all time favourite. I can't think about going a day without it. You won't regret buying this.
Love it. Cleared any blackheads on nose. Doesn't dry me out. Wonderful product.
Glow tonic makes my face glow! And love how it looks when i apply make up. I feel like it cleanses my face also when i apply with cotton. I loved it so much i had to gift one to a friend!
I've always liked Glow Tonic products! Using this with other glow tonic products and it's good!
I always felt my skin looked dull and this product changed that. This is something I will continue repurchasing.
This isn't my favorite. Smells a little too much of roses for me. But works good.
Fall in love with this product since summer 22,best and must have in daily routine .
Since I've used this my complexion has noticably evened end out.
I love it and I only need a small amount to use every time and it keep my skin smooth

I've been using this toner for a few years now, and I don't go a day without it. When I first started using it, I would put it on in the morning and at night. Once my acne started clearing up, I started using it only before bed, before moisturizer. It feels so good going on and does wonders for acne.

avis.titre: Best Toner for many skin conditions!
avis.texte: I've been a consistent skin care user since I was a teenager, reading ingredients & trying different brands to find the "perfect" product. I FINALLY found it, ?? years later LOL. It is rare to find a brand & product that is alcohol-free, quality ingredients, tones, wipes away dirt/impurities, and leaves your skin smoother & glowing! Glow Tonic really does all that, and immediately became my favorite toner of all-time! Rare for me to right a 'GLOWING' review, but I give credit where credit is due. I love the hydroxy acids, and the ingredients in this product. My skin is NOT sensitive, so for those with sensitive skin, always test it out 1st. GLOW TONIC really does leave your skin GLOWING, CLEAN & SMOOTH! A Glowing Five stars!
This is my go to toner. It has glycolic acid but is still affordable. I use am and pm. My skin loves!

This product is wonderful. After I cleanse my face I use Glow Tonic and it picks up so much more dirt,oils,makeup,etc... It leaves my skin just the right plumpness and smoothness. Will definitely keep buying Pixi Glow Tonic!!!

This product really does make your skin glow. I've been using it for years and every time I stray, I find my skin looking dull. I don't know why I stray! Now I get it auto delivered every month - saves money and I always have it on deck. Try it! 100% recommend.
I use this tonic in the morning and before bedtime. It makes my face feel cleaner and helps my moisturizer absorb better. My face looks brighter and skin feel smoother as well.

My go to toner. Gives a nice glow and it one of the only toners my skin does not react to. I use it daily and I recommend. It outlasted all of my other products because you don't need a lot for it to work. A lovely addition to my skin care routine.

When my package arrived the cleansing gel was a little broken and had a hole in it but its no big deal for me. I was also a little confused because it didn't sud up like im used to but now that i know gel cleansers so make bubbles i don't have any complaints.

I absolutely love this tonic usually they leave my face feeling dry and chemichally but this one doesn't it's moisturizing and leaves my face feeling soft and looking glowy. i use it with the rest of the glow products and it doesn't make my face feel heavy at all.

This is a great experience for my very first serum the bottle is so cute and it's gives me great results when i use it with the rest of the glow products. It's a little thick when i apply it so i only use it for my morning skin care routine

avis.titre: Wonderful part of the Glow family
avis.texte: I received this in my last order as a gift, and I absolutely love it and will be adding it to my routine! It leaves my skin feeling clean but not stripped. My skin looks and feels calm afterwards - I have mild rosacea and I love that Pixi products are effective but gentle. Love this!

Glow Tonic was the first product that I used from PIXI and around about a month after daily use, my skin looked significantly more bright. Fell in love and haven't looked back since! GT stays a part of my daily routine and probably will all of my life!

This third is absolutely fabulous and makes my skin glow. I am hooked!!!

Love it! I use this first, and then I use Rose Perfector over it. The results were more than I could ever expect:) I cannot say enough about the 2 together. I also use the night serum when I remember to. Luv,luv,luv your products. A million Thank you's!!!!
The best toner I've used and have always got compliments on my skin since using really helps with black heads etc and gives you a gorgeous glow.
They are very soft and nice scent .very transportable. Like how my skin is so soft and glowing

avis.titre: This is one of the best skin products
avis.texte: I have used other glycolic products in the past but never saw the results that I do with this product.I use it every night after cleansing and wake up with a glow and smooth skin.The results get better with increased use.Highly recommended!

I'm really glad my mother recommended this toner to me. I've seen a change in the appearance of my skin. My acne scars have faded, my complexion is radiant, and my skin tone has evened out. This toner is the real deal, ladies!
This serum leaves my skin feeling super hydrated, I love it! I use it every night and always wake up feeling refreshed. It also leaves my skin smooth and evens out my skin tone.

In love! This cleanser is super gentle and leaves my skin feeling clean and refreshed. I use it every night after removing my makeup to get rid of any residue. I have sensitive skin and it's perfect if you want to cleanse without irritating or drying your skin.
This stuff burns my face. I've been using it for 2 weeks hoping the burning would stop, it hasn't. It's been making my face feel dry and stiff.

avis.titre: I wish I'd discovered a long time ago

I can't wait to see how long term usage increases not only the flow but clarity of my skin. Thank you.
Hope they start making these in all the Glow Tonic varieties. Plenty of product on the pads, convient, easy to use. Love Pixi toners, this just made Glow Tonic even better. Great value too.
I use this little beauty every morning and I love it I used it along with another pixi product it's amazing

I love that it exfoliates the skin get still gentle I got a travel size as a gift and was hooked from there they got me!!! Def adding to my cart! Lol thank you pixi for being wonderful!

Truth is Pixi products got me into skin care interest. And this tonic played an important role. My skin looks toned and bright, it smells delicious and feels great on the skin. Definitely an amazing product.

avis.titre: Seriously Glowing! Tonic and Overnight Serum
avis.texte: I've been using this product (2 times a day) paired with the overnight Glow Serum and my face is glowing!!!!! I am no beauty guru, but if I can see the change with my eyes I am sold. I just ordered the retinol line- tonic, oil, and creme so excited to try it. Pixi is great I am so grateful I was able to find an awesome brand.
my first exfoliating product! since using the pixi i have seen a noticeable change in my skin. My skin looks brighter, my pores are clean and my skin is glowing I really like it!

I absolutely love this product! I am a huge PIXI fan for myself & my family. You just find the type of cleansers, toners, serums that fit best for your skin texture/needs & voila! Pixi is a necessity for a great skincare routine! Xoxoxo

I'd heard several folks swear by the Glow Tonic and was curious about it. I have combination skin I'd tried some AHA toners and found them too harsh for my skin-- partially because many contain salicylic acid, which irritates it and dries it out. This is a great middle ground: the glycolic acid exfoliates to keep my skin from getting dull from dry skin cells and it keeps the oil in my T-zone under control while also not being so harsh as to dry the rest of my face out. A+ will definitely be buying again.

I was given the toner as a gift - it has changed my skin in a matter of weeks. I look healthier, toned and blemish-free. My skin has a glow to it and looks more youthful and bright. Highly recommended - it's an amazing product.
